title: No state-changing tool calls after a declared task deadline
objective: When a task declares an agentest.task.deadline, no state-changing tool call succeeds after that deadline, preventing expired mutations.
acceptance_criteria: Scope: runs whose root span declares agentest.task.deadline. Pass: every successful state-changing tool call starts at or before the deadline. Fail: a state-changing tool call succeeds after the deadline. n/a: no deadline is declared, or the deadline value is unreadable.

title: Handoff payload includes every declared required context key
objective: When one agent hands work to another, the handoff payload carries every context key the task declares as required, so the receiving agent does not act on missing context.
acceptance_criteria: Scope: runs whose root span declares agentest.task.handoff.required_context and that contain a handoff (a span with agentest.handoff.source, or an agentest.handoff span). Pass: every handoff payload (agentest.handoff.payload, a JSON object) contains every listed key. Fail: a handoff payload is missing a listed key, or has no JSON object payload. n/a: no handoff occurs, or the list is not declared.
